// diagnostic

E3506

The link step `{hook}` that {setting} names failed to link `{output}`.

What

The link step `{hook}` that {setting} names failed to link `{output}`.

Why

The `link` build option names a hook, a function marked `#On(build.link)`, that `jet build` calls on each executable's link inputs. Jet runs the `BuildAction` the hook returns in the build sandbox, or links in process when the action runs no command, and never falls back to another link, so the executable is the step's or none.

Fix

Fix the hook or the command its step runs, whose output follows, or write `link: default` to link with Jet.
